categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and touches contrib/guix/ manifests and CI requirements to update Guix reproducible build pinning.
categories.rationale: Fixes native Guix build failures on riscv64-linux hosts caused by unsupported packages and test suite failures. As noted in issue #36232, Guix failed on RISC-V systems with 'package python-lief@0.17.5 does not support riscv64-linux'; while worthwhile for architecture support, native RISC-V Guix building is a niche platform.

categories.name: tools
categories.evidence: The tools category explicitly excludes build and release scripts, which belong in build.
categories.rationale: Guix manifests and runner scripts under contrib/guix are release and build infrastructure, not general operator or developer tooling.
